description: Captures the highest and lowest voltage each channel of two signals has reached, for tracking down pops and clicks

params.text: Clears the captured peaks for that signal and starts the capture again
Sets the voltage at which the red lamps come on, 0-12V, starting at 12V; a lamp lights when any channel goes above it or below its negative

inputs.text: The signal whose peaks are captured, polyphonic

outputs.text: The highest voltage that signal has reached on each channel since its last reset
The lowest voltage that signal has reached on each channel since its last reset

notes: the captured peaks show in the tooltip of each output port whether or not anything is patched to it
